description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SmartphoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDetails" name="Phone model and fault details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsList" name="Materials list"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Review" name="Repair review"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairVideo" name="Repair video"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpertRepair" name="Phone sent for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SmartphoneOwner" name="DIY smartphone screen repair" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Owner" name="Start repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDetails" name="Submit phone details" messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsSplit" name="Receive tool outputs"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMaterials" name="Receive materials list" messageRef="Message_MaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTools" name="Receive tools list" messageRef="Message_ToolsList"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices" name="Receive ordering choices for each part" messageRef="Message_OrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsJoin" name="All tool outputs received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckItems" name="Check which items are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ItemsMissing" name="Are any items missing?" default="Flow_NoItemsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsCanHelp" name="Can friends provide items cheaply or by borrowing?" default="Flow_NoFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items" messageRef="Message_FriendsRequest"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsMerge" name="Continue item procurement"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestInstructions" name="Request repair instructions" messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix smartphone screen"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?" default="Flow_NotWorked"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Send review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to an expert" messageRef="Message_ExpertRepair"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackSent" name="Review and/or video sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnerStart_Enter" sourceRef="Start_Owner" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Submit" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_SubmitDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_ReceiveSplit" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSplit_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSplit_Tools" sourceRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSplit_Choices" sourceRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_ReceiveJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tools_ReceiveJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTools" targetRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choices_ReceiveJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices" targetRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveJoin_Check" sourceRef="Gateway_ReceiveOutputsJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Missing" sourceRef="Task_CheckItems" targetRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemsMissing_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsCanHelp">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Items needed for the repair are missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoItemsMissing" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing" targetRef="Task_RequestInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsCanHelp" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Friends can provide at least one needed item by borrowing or buying cheaply</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFriends" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsCanHelp" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsMerge_Buy" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_RequestInstructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_RequestInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_ReceiveInstructions" sourceRef="Task_RequestInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInstructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Review" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Send a review</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Video" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Send a video</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_FeedbackJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_FeedbackJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="End_FeedbackSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolDetails" name="Receive phone details">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ToolDetails" messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ToolOutputsSplit" name="Prepare repair information"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideMaterials" name="Provide materials list" messageRef="Message_MaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideTools" name="Provide tools list" messageRef="Message_ToolsList"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" name="Provide ordering choices for each part" messageRef="Message_OrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ToolOutputsJoin" name="Repair information provided"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ToolOutputs" name="Repair information delivered"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolInstructions" name="Receive request for instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ToolInstructions" messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ToolInstructions" name="Instructions delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolStart_Split" sourceRef="Start_ToolDetails" targetRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolSplit_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolSplit_Tools" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolSplit_Choices" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_ToolJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tools_ToolJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTools" targetRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choices_ToolJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" targetRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolOutputsJoin" targetRef="End_ToolOutputs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolInstructions_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="End_ToolInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolInstructionStart_Provide" sourceRef="Start_ToolInstructions" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Smartphone owner" processRef="Process_SmartphoneOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_OnlineTool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Details" name="Phone model and fault details" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Start_ToolDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials list" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMaterials" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tools" name="Tools list" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTools" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTools"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Choices" name="Ordering choices for each part" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Repair instructions" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Friends" name="Ask friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" name="Repair review" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_Tool"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Video" name="Repair video" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_Tool"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Expert" name="Send phone for expert help" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
